verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Render, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions hardware isolation, microVMs, or sandboxing untrusted code. The closest items are short-lived service instances for one-off commands and ephemeral preview environments, which are adjacent features rather than isolated disposable sandboxes for untrusted code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
